programme.title: Žogarija
programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Jake Knapp – Handling Drivable Par 4s
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Patty Tavatanakit
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: Cyclisme : Tour de Langkawi
programme.desc: Le Tour de Langkawi est une course cycliste par étapes disputée en Malaisie. Elle tire son nom de l'archipel de Langkawi, où fut donné le départ de la première édition en 1996.

programme.title: Whistler | Descente Élite (H)
programme.desc: La coupe du monde de VTT fait étape au Canada, à Whistler, en Colombie-Britannique, pour l'avant-dernière manche de descente de la saison. Au classement général, c'est l'Anglais Jordan Williams qui domine les débats. Côté français, Amaury Pierron, Max Alran, Loïc Bruni et Benoît Coulanges espèrent monter sur le podium.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.title: CRO Race | 6e étape
programme.desc: La 6e et dernière étape de la CRO Race 2026 relie Samobor à Zagreb, sur une distance de 159,5 kilomètres. Cette ultime étape scellera le classement général de cette course.

programme.title: 6 Heures de Fuji | Course
programme.desc: La 6e manche du championnat du monde d'endurance de la FIA se déroule sur le mythique circuit du Fuji Speedway, au Japon. Le championnat des constructeurs est dominé par Toyota.

programme.title: Tennis : Laver Cup
programme.desc: Suivez des matchs de la Laver Cup, une compétition de tennis masculine opposant une équipe Europe à une équipe Monde. Ce tournoi, initié sous l'impulsion de Roger Federer, porte le nom de Rod Laver, un joueur de tennis professionnel australien. La première édition a eu lieu en 2017. Les éditions de cette compétition se déroulent en Europe et dans le reste du monde.

programme.title: Snooker : Shenzhen Open
programme.desc: Organisé à Xi'an en 2024 et 2025 sous l'appellation Grand Prix de Xi'an, le tournoi change de localisation en 2026 pour Shenzhen. Cette épreuve fait partie des six événements prévus en Chine pour la saison 2026/2027 de snooker. Le Gallois Mark Williams en est le tenant du titre. L'an dernier, il avait battu l'Anglais Shaun Murphy en finale, sur le score de 10 manches à 3.

programme.desc: La course en ligne dames se déroule sur une distance de 180,4 km entre Brossard et Montréal, au Canada, pour un parcours exigeant totalisant environ 2500 m de dénivelé positif.

programme.title: Jinshanling Great Wall Trail Race | Épreuves (H/F)
programme.desc: La Jinshanling Great Wall est l'une des étapes les plus spectaculaires de la Golden Trail World Series. Elle est l'ultime opportunité pour l'élite mondiale avant la grande finale.

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de descente
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de descente, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.title: 6 Heures de Fuji | Course
programme.desc: La 6e manche du championnat du monde d'endurance de la FIA se déroule sur le mythique circuit du Fuji Speedway, au Japon. Le championnat des constructeurs est dominé par Toyota.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Koper, en Slovénie, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de Coupe du monde de difficulté. Chez les messieurs, la victoire devrait se jouer entre le Japonais Neo Suzuki, l'Espagnol Alberto Ginés Lopez, l'Indonésien Putra Tri Ramadani et le local Luka Potocar. Chez les dames, l'Américaine Annie Sanders et la Slovène Janja Garnbret partent favorites. A suivre aussi la Française Zélia Avezou qui avait décroché le bronze à Prague, en juin dernier.

programme.title: ATP 250 Chengdu
programme.desc: Le Chengdu Open est un tournoi dans la catégorie des ATP 250 Series et se dispute sur dur en extérieur, dans la province chinoise du Sichuan.

programme.title: Tennis : Tournoi ATP de Hangzhou
programme.desc: En Chine orientale, le Hangzhou Open est un tournoi ATP 250 organisé pour la première fois en 2024 en remplacement du tournoi de Zhuhai.

programme.title: Cyclisme : Championnats du monde sur route
programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.title: Snooker : Shenzhen Open
programme.desc: Parmi les joueurs qui prennent part à cette édition du Shenzhen Open, on retrouve le nouveau numéro un mondial, le Chinois Zhao Xintong, mais aussi l'Anglais Judd Trump, l'Australien Neil Robertson, le tenant du titre Mark Williams, les Anglais Ronnie O'Sullivan, Kyren Wilson, Mark Allen et Chris Wakelin ou encore l'Ecossais John Higgins et les Chinois Ding Junhui, Xiao Guodong et Wu Yize.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Guiyang, capitale de la province du Guizhou en Chine, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de coupe du monde de vitesse, en escalade. Chez les messieurs, les Chinois Zhao Yicheng, Shouhong Chu et Jianguo Long sont attendus à domicile, avec l'Américain Samuel Watson et le champion olympique indonésien Veddriq Leonardo. Chez les dames, l'Indonésienne Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, victorieuse de deux manches sur quatre cette saison, est la favorite.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: A Guiyang, les Chinoises Fan Jingyue et Zhang Shaoqin ont décroché l'or à domicile devant l'Espagne. Le relais français, composé de Capucine Viglione et Louise Fontaine, a terminé 4e, mais s'est offert le record de France. Chez les messieurs, la paire chinoise Ling Yongzhi et Zhao Yicheng a survolé la compétition et même pulvérisé le record du monde avec un chrono extraordinaire de 9''58.

programme.title: Motocross : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Suivez des courses du Championnat du monde de motocross. Chaque année, les meilleurs pilotes du monde s'affrontent pour le titre décerné par la Fédération internationale de motocyclisme. De mars à octobre, ils concourent sur 20 circuits en Europe, en Asie, en Amérique du Sud et du Nord. Le championnat du monde se déroule dans les catégories de moteurs MXGP, MX2 et MX3.

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: VTT : Coupe du monde de descente
programme.desc: Suivez la Coupe du monde de descente, une série de courses de VTT multi-épreuves gérée par l'Union Cycliste Internationale. La première série de Coupes du monde, composée d'épreuves de cross-country, a eu lieu en 1989. La Coupe du monde de descente a été inaugurée deux ans plus tard, et celle de slalom double en 1998. Les coureurs gagnent des points en fonction de leur classement dans chaque épreuve.

programme.desc: Koper, en Slovénie, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de Coupe du monde de difficulté. programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Guiyang, capitale de la province du Guizhou en Chine, accueille l'avant-dernière manche de la saison de coupe du monde de vitesse, en escalade. Chez les messieurs, les Chinois Zhao Yicheng, Shouhong Chu et Jianguo Long sont attendus à domicile, avec l'Américain Samuel Watson et le champion olympique indonésien Veddriq Leonardo. Chez les dames, l'Indonésienne Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, victorieuse de deux manches sur quatre cette saison, est la favorite.

programme.title: Escalade : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: A Guiyang, les Chinoises Fan Jingyue et Zhang Shaoqin ont décroché l'or à domicile devant l'Espagne. Le relais français, composé de Capucine Viglione et Louise Fontaine, a terminé 4e, mais s'est offert le record de France. Chez les messieurs, la paire chinoise Ling Yongzhi et Zhao Yicheng a survolé la compétition et même pulvérisé le record du monde avec un chrono extraordinaire de 9''58.

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way
